CLIExperience:cliExperience.configFields: Configuration fields (? allows null; an empty string is different from null):
CLIExperience:cliExperience.configRules: Scopes: app, defaults, instance:<uuid>. set accepts a JSON literal (retain double quotes around strings); apply --file - reads a patch from stdin. inherit restores group inheritance; --if-revision guards concurrent changes.
CLIExperience:cliExperience.discovery: Discovery: ruri help <resource> shows a whole command group; ruri help --all shows the complete cheat sheet.
CLIExperience:cliExperience.formats: Default: concise text. --json: stable structured result. --output ndjson: event stream. --data-dir <path>: data directory. --language en|zh-Hans: message language (default: en). --quiet: hide progress.
CLIExperience:cliExperience.fullSchema: Expand every matching command's full schema; output may be large.
CLIExperience:cliExperience.helpAll: Show a concise index of every command.
CLIExperience:cliExperience.inputSchema: Return only the command input schema, including the patch schema for config apply.
CLIExperience:cliExperience.listRules: Lists return up to 50 items by default. Paginate with --limit <1…1000> / --offset <count>, or use --all.
CLIExperience:cliExperience.outputSchema: Return only the command result schema.
CLIExperience:cliExperience.rules: Use complete IDs from list results. Mutations require explicit targets; selected reads the current selection. Use --dry-run where supported. Deletion requires --yes; replacement also requires --replace.
CLIExperience:cliExperience.schemaHint: Strict schemas: ruri schema <resource> <action> --input or --output-schema; configuration supports --scope app|defaults|instance.
CLIExperience:cliExperience.schemaScope: Limit configuration fields to app, defaults, or instance.
CLIExperience:cliExperience.schemaSelect: --input, --output-schema, and --scope require an exact command. --scope applies only to configuration inputs.
CLIExperience:cliExperience.unknownHelp: Unknown command: %@. Run ruri help --all to list commands.

CLISetup:cliSetup.authorizationHint: Installing or uninstalling may require administrator authorization.
CLISetup:cliSetup.authorizationRequired: The installation directory requires administrator permission. Open Command line and automation in Ruri settings to authorize installation or removal, or choose an existing writable directory with --bin-dir.
CLISetup:cliSetup.authorizeInstall: Ruri needs to install the CLI in /usr/local/bin. You can then use ruri in a terminal without configuring PATH.
CLISetup:cliSetup.authorizeUninstall: Ruri needs to remove the installed CLI link. This does not delete the application or game data.
CLISetup:cliSetup.footer: Use Ruri CLI to manage instances, accounts, and settings, directly or through an AI agent.
CLISetup:cliSetup.introduction: Install Ruri CLI to use it in a terminal without configuring PATH.

Wait for the monitor to finalize, or check the game.

The process identity still matches. Exit through the game's menu first. Console output may no longer be saved.
The command process still exists. Stop it in Activity Monitor before recovering the record. The command will not run again.
The original game process is gone. The instance can be recovered for launching again. Exit code and end time are unknown.
The game process could not be verified. Confirm it has exited in the game, Dock, or Activity Monitor before recovering.
The monitor was interrupted while finalizing exit. Recorded exit code and playtime are preserved. The post-exit command will not run again.
